snippet.title: KILLFLOW Announcement Trailer | ClusterFame Games
snippet.description:
Wishlist the Game on Steam!: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4425610/KILLFLOW/

KILLFLOW is an insanely fast retro FPS set in a stylish procedurally generating world. Destroy red psychopaths with destructive weapons to save yourself from getting corrupted, and get the high score.

More links:
Website - https://clusterfame.com/killflow
Twitter - https://twitter.com/ClusterFame
